name: net_playout_paces_turns
description: The playout (design 6.3): the first tick waits for B turns; B comes from the pings (2 to 6 turns); it plays 60 ticks a second, 5% slower below B and 5% faster above B + 1; more than 20 turns behind it catches up at 8 ticks a frame; with nothing buffered it waits.

steps.msg: one turn at hand is less than B = 2: the first tick waits
two turns: it starts, one tick a frame
near B it plays 60 ticks in 60 frames
22 turns behind: it catches up at 8 ticks a frame
back near B it plays at the normal pace again

steps.assert: probe.buffer(20, 0) == 2 and probe.buffer(120, 0) == 3 and probe.buffer(100, 80) == 5 and probe.buffer(900, 0) == 6
steps.msg: B = ceil((mean + 2 spread) / 50 ms), from 2 to 6 turns
a 240 ms round trip asks for 5 turns
a dev server's 10 ms turns play 5 ticks a frame
